description: This class includes the manufacture of footwear of any material by any process, including moulding.
includes: manufacture of leather footwear: shoes, boots, sandals
manufacture of rubber or plastic footwear
manufacture of wooden footwear and footwear with outer soles of wood
manufacture of parts of footwear: uppers, soles, heels, inner soles
excludes: manufacture of protective metal toe-caps, see 2599
